provider_source.source_of_truth_boundary: AOF export summarizes local runtime evidence, not raw provider transcript truth.

event_summaries.summary: Operator requested Japanese Mission Control with task, organization, product completion, and test status views.
AOF opened TASK-128 and scoped the dashboard improvement as runtime-backed operator visibility work.
AOF runtime commands assessed status, exported visibility payloads, updated task state, and audited release readiness.
Mission Control implementation and focused runtime test were updated.
Focused runtime tests, organization verification, smoke, and release audit are required evidence for completion.
Release-state-audit detected missing TASK-128 governance artifacts after the implementation was marked done.
TASK-128 cannot be release-ready until the governance chain and full tests pass.

risk_candidates: Japanese dashboard may still need browser/operator visual review after structural tests pass.
decision_candidates: Treat TASK-128 as a localized operator visibility improvement, not a full Mission Control redesign.

redaction_boundary: The export excludes raw provider transcript and secrets; it records bounded local AOF artifact refs and summaries.
release_ready_boundary: Release-ready means TASK-128 has code, runtime evidence, governance artifacts, and tests; it does not prove every future dataset renders perfectly.
not_proven: This record does not prove semantic Japanese copy quality or third-party operator comprehension.
notes: Created after release-state-audit exposed missing governance evidence for TASK-128.
